contentBlocks.body: Because filter, map, and sort each return an array, you can chain them into a pipeline that reads top to bottom. Keep each step doing one thing so the chain stays easy to follow.
sort compares as strings by default, so always pass a comparator like (a, b) => b - a for numbers.

knowledgeItems.prompt: Why can you chain .filter(...).sort(...) on an array?

choices: each method returns an array to call the next on
payload.answer: each method returns an array to call the next on
payload.explanation: filter and sort both yield arrays, so the next method has something to operate on.

knowledgeItems.prompt: Return scores that are at least 80, sorted from highest to lowest.
